purpose: Teach: 大将/造っ/初戦/日立/造形/フラワー/チューブ/ムリ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お父さん、寿司屋の大将みたいで、料理上手だよね、家でも。
lines.en: Your dad's got real skills in the kitchen, Riku — reminds me of a sushi master or something.
lines.style: Warm, teasing brightness. Quick rhythm with a playful lilt. Leaning toward him with genuine appreciation underneath the light jab.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。プラモ、新作、お祖父ちゃん、造ったって、見せてくれたよ、昨日。
lines.en: Yeah. My grandpa showed me this new model kit he built yesterday — pretty cool.
lines.style: Slight brightening on the memory. Natural, unforced. Voice opens up when talking about the plamo, then settles back. Genuine pleasure without needing to perform it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化部、初戦、私たち、惨敗だったよ、対戦相手、強かったね。
lines.en: Our club got absolutely demolished in the first round. The other team was just on another level.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware laugh buried just under the surface. Matter-of-fact about the loss but with a hint of rueful humor. No self-pity, just wry acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家電量販店、日立コーナー、結構、品揃え、いいよな、近所の。
lines.en: The Hitachi section at that big electronics store near us has a pretty decent selection, actually.
lines.style: Slightly distant, observational tone. Slow, thoughtful pace like he's noticing something he hadn't expected to care about. Conversational but reflective.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 美術部で、造形作品、文化祭、出すんだ、私、最近、頑張ってる。
lines.en: I'm actually putting some sculpture work in the art show at the culture festival this year. Been working pretty hard on it lately.
lines.style: Earnest forward momentum. Pride underneath — not boastful but genuine investment in what she's saying. Slight rise in energy when naming the project.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 校門前の、フラワーショップ、新しく、できたぜ、結構、人気らしい。
lines.en: There's a new flower shop that opened up in front of the school gate. People seem to really like it.
lines.style: Casual, easy observation shared like he's passing on a small thing he noticed. Light energy, no particular investment in the topic itself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 絵の具のチューブ、なかなか、減らないよね、リク、わかる?
lines.en: Paint tubes take forever to run out, don't they? You know what I mean?
lines.style: Playful, searching-for-agreement tone. Light and conspiratorial, like she's calling him in on a shared small truth about the art-making life.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト前、ムリしすぎるなよ、桜、体調、第一だぜ。
lines.en: Don't push yourself too hard before the test, okay Sakura? Your health comes first, seriously.
lines.style: Quieter, protective undertone. Not lecturing — sincere concern that comes out steady and direct. A moment where the cool exterior softens. Eye-contact earnest.
